title: Plan, No Plan · season 2, ep 1: No Folder
season_arc:
PREMISE AND THREAD: The swap. Timo has typed his first sentence and says he has quit planning; in truth he now plans by hand only what one sentence never covers (himself, Luna, the cat, Big Yellow), and Luna, who never read a plan in her life, carries his folder. Each episode is a different sports trip with one sport to watch and one thing to do; whoever's way did not win that day types the next trip in ONE sentence, and that Venuvoy card, a new place and a new sport, is the last thing before the stare, so the brand moment is the cliffhanger. Under it run a friendly count with nothing staked and never next to a game's result, and one coral page at the back of the folder ("surprise Luna"), seen from episode 2 and opened in episode 4.
EP 1, No Folder (New York, basketball): he carries "one sentence", she pushes Big Yellow, and his plan for having no plan, hidden inside it, says she will push and carry; his plan wins, she carries, and she types Manchester: football and a round of golf.
EP 2, Forty-Two Swings (Manchester, a football match and a round of golf): Luna carries the folder round the course like a golf bag while Timo reads out 42 steps for one swing ("The plan took one sentence. So I planned the swing."); she just swings, the cat sits on his ball, her way wins and he pushes Big Yellow again; he types his second sentence, a motorsport weekend.
EP 3, Pit Stop (a motorsport weekend): a wheel comes off Big Yellow on the way to the track, one sentence cannot mend a suitcase, and Timo's 42-step pit stop can: his first win that is no trick, in a field Venuvoy never claims; Luna types a match and a hike in the mountains.
EP 4, Uphill (a match and a hike): Big Yellow has to go up a mountain and neither way works alone, so they carry it together, one side each; at the top the coral page is his surprise, a sentence written by hand for a sport neither has tried, and she typed one for him the same night: two "Done."s, this time Luna stares into the camera, follow for season 3. (Before episodes 3 and 4 are written, place and month are checked against the catalog: motorsport with no fixed race date, the hike only in one of the nine countries where the planner places hikes, the last sport only one with events, such as tennis or rugby.)
logline: Timo says he has quit planning and lets Luna push her giant suitcase herself, but his secret plan is hidden inside it and says she will carry that too, so Luna types their next trip in one sentence: golf, the one thing he has no plan for.

shots.place: Timo's room on the morning of the trip: the room of season 1, episode 1 (window on the left, violet bean bag, low golden light from the left). ONE new room master is drawn by editing the season 1 room picture; shots 2 and 3 are drawn from it.
shots.who: Timo, Luna, Big Yellow, the cat
shots.picture: Wide, locked, the framing of the very first shot of the series. The back wall, once covered in notes and red strings, is bare: rows of empty pins, pale squares where papers hung, and in the exact middle ONE small blank ivory sheet on one pin. TIMO stands on the RIGHT, very straight and proud, chin up, one arm stretched toward the single sheet like a teacher; teal track jacket with cream sleeve stripes, navy trousers, teal-and-coral scarf, straps of the tiny teal backpack on both shoulders, big yellow watch on his LEFT wrist; no folder anywhere in the room. LUNA lies sprawled on the violet bean bag on the LEFT, a plain orange basketball (no logo) resting in the crook of her arm on her stomach, looking up at the wall with one eyebrow up; coral football shirt, denim shorts, plain teal scarf. BIG YELLOW stands packed and upright beside the bean bag, the fat ginger CAT loafed on its flat top, asleep. The top fifth of the frame is only bare wall. No writing anywhere.
shots.action: Timo sweeps his arm across the empty wall and ends pointing at the single sheet, chin up. Nothing else moves: Luna only looks, the cat sleeps. Sound: his voice, a quiet room. Music: the groove starts on frame one.

lines.text: No notes. No folder. One sentence.

shots.label: he says he quit planning

shots.place: Timo's room, closer on Timo in front of the bare wall (drawn from the room master). Filmed as a 5-second clip.
shots.picture: TIMO alone from the waist up, the single ivory sheet soft behind his shoulder. His phone is ALREADY flat against his chest in his right hand, its BACK to the camera (plain teal case, no logo; the screen is never seen); his left hand on his hip, so the yellow watch shows on his LEFT wrist; eyes half closed, a small smug smile, mouth closed. Backpack straps on both shoulders, teal-and-coral scarf at his throat. His head sits in the LOWER half of the frame; the upper third is empty wall, kept free for the graphics.
shots.action: He stands still for a second and a half, then gives one slow, proud nod and says his two short lines. The phone does not move and its screen is never seen. Sound: his voice; the typing, one ding and four pops come from the edit.
shots.venuvoy: 0.2 s: the green VENUVOY name plate with the round V crest, top of frame. 0.3 to 1.5 s, while he stands still: on the ivory card his sentence appears word by word: "a week in New York, basketball, me and Luna" (exactly nine words, so his first line is true on screen). On his "Done." (about 3.0 s) four ticks pop one after another, 3.0 to 3.5 s: the game · ticket links · getting around · day by day. Everything stays to the cut; if the clip runs short, its last frame is held so the ticks stay a full second.

shots.place: Timo's room, close on Luna on the bean bag (the framing of "Nice. Can I come?" in season 1; drawn from the room master).
shots.picture: LUNA alone on the violet bean bag, head and shoulders filling the middle of the frame: she has sat bolt upright, the plain orange basketball hugged against her chest with her left arm, eyebrows high, eyes wide on Timo (out of frame on the right), mouth open. Behind her shoulder the yellow side of BIG YELLOW with the CAT loafed on top, eyes shut. Window light from the left. Coral shirt, plain teal scarf with no coral on it.
shots.action: She points at him with her whole open right hand, and her outrage breaks into a wide grin as she says it. The ball and the cat do not move.

shots.place: A pavement in New York, drawn as the series' sunny art-toy model town grown tall: the ONE new master picture of the film. Big pale stone slabs; along the back a low plain cream wall, behind it a small street court with one hoop on a pole (plain white backboard); soft toy brownstone houses with front steps and round water towers on the roofs; far back at the kerb one parked plain yellow cab with dark windows, no roof sign and no markings, which never moves; at the far LEFT end of the street a round cream arena with a giant orange basketball on its roof. Low golden morning sun from the left. No people, no signs, no writing. Street camera position 1 of 3: the wide side view.
shots.who: Timo, Luna, Big Yellow, the cat
shots.picture: Wide side view, locked, everyone from head to shoes: the last ride of season 1 (ep 4, clip g9) with the roles swapped and the same direction, right to left; the figures and the suitcase are drawn from a frame of that clip. LUNA on the right pushes BIG YELLOW with both hands flat on its back, already leaning in at a steep angle in the first frame, cheeks puffed, eyebrows down; coral football shirt, denim shorts, plain teal scarf hanging. The fat ginger CAT lies loafed on the suitcase top, eyes half shut. Then a clear gap of one suitcase width. On the left TIMO strolls ahead with his hands clasped behind his head, eyes closed, smiling; tiny teal backpack on his back, yellow watch on his LEFT wrist, teal-and-coral scarf. The two bodies never overlap. Behind them the low wall and the hoop; the arena with the orange ball small at the far left. The top fifth is sky.
shots.action: Luna pushes; Big Yellow rolls slowly and heavily. Timo strolls ahead at the same slow speed and says his line without looking back. The cat rides without moving. Sound: heavy wheels on stone, her small grunt, his voice.
shots.label: so today, she carries

shots.place: The same pavement, street camera position 2 (from the front, the street soft behind): closer on Luna behind the suitcase. Drawn from the New York master and from the last frame of shot 4.
shots.picture: LUNA seen from the front over the flat top of BIG YELLOW, stopped: both forearms dropped on the suitcase top, head hanging, cheeks red, mouth open, out of breath. Her coral bob is one solid shape, nothing stuck to her forehead. The CAT lies loafed on the suitcase top beside her arms, facing the camera, eyes half closed. The street soft behind. Timo is not in the frame.
shots.action: She lifts her head and looks down at the suitcase as she asks. The cat does not move. Music: a full stop on the word "pack".

shots.place: The same pavement, camera position 2, a few steps ahead: close on Timo.
shots.picture: TIMO alone from the chest up, seen from the front, STANDING STILL (not in mid-stride): hands still clasped behind his head, the smile frozen on his face, eyes now wide open. Backpack straps on both shoulders, teal-and-coral scarf at his throat, yellow watch on his LEFT wrist. Luna and the suitcase are behind him, out of frame. The top third of the frame is sky and soft houses.
shots.action: Only his eyes move: they slide slowly to one side, toward her behind him. Then, without turning his head, he tries it in a small voice. No music at all: street air and his voice.

shots.place: The same pavement, camera position 3: down at an angle onto the stone slabs, nothing else in view, so no background has to match. Big Yellow is drawn from the two suitcase reference pictures (same yellow, same ribs), the folder from a season 1 frame.
shots.picture: HARD CUT. BIG YELLOW lies wide open on the pale stone like a clam. The left half holds Luna's things, few and big: a pile of coral shirts, one rolled plain teal scarf, the plain orange basketball. The right half is filled to the edge by ONE very thick plain blue folder stuffed with white paper, no label on it. The fat ginger CAT ALREADY stands with all four paws on the folder, looking down at it. No people in the frame. No writing anywhere.
shots.action: The cat sits down heavily in the middle of the folder and looks straight up into the camera, unimpressed. Nothing else moves. Music: the first kick of the drop exactly on the cut. Sound: paper creaking under the cat.
shots.label: his plan for having no plan

shots.place: The same pavement, camera position 2: close on Luna. Filmed as a 5-second clip.
shots.picture: LUNA alone from the waist up, holding the thick blue folder open in both hands like a huge book, its plain blue covers toward the camera (the pages are never seen), her eyes down on the first page, a grin already starting. The folder is in her hands when the shot begins: nothing is passed. Her head is in the lower half of the frame; the top third is soft sky and houses.
shots.action: Her eyes run along one line and she reads the first step out with a grin; her eyes drop again, go wide, and she looks up over the edge of the folder toward Timo (out of frame on the right) with a laughing gasp as she reads the second. The folder does not move.

lines.text: Step two: Luna pushes Big Yellow?!

shots.label: he planned her too

shots.place: The same pavement, camera position 2: close on Timo, drawn from the picture of shot 6.
shots.picture: TIMO alone from the waist up, seen from the front, standing tall: chin up, eyes half closed, a small proud smile, mouth closed. Both hands are already open at hip height, palms up, completely empty; yellow watch on his LEFT wrist, backpack straps on both shoulders, teal-and-coral scarf. The street soft behind. His head sits in the middle band; the top quarter of the frame is free for the label.
shots.action: He lifts both empty hands a little wider and says it from memory, chin going up; he ends beaming. Music: the drop in full swing.

lines.text: Step three: Luna carries the folder.

shots.label: his plan wins. she carries.

shots.place: The same pavement, camera position 2: close on Luna, drawn from the picture of shot 8. Filmed as a 5-second clip.
shots.picture: LUNA alone from the waist up, seen from the front. The closed thick blue folder is clamped under her LEFT arm against her side (it is as wide as she is, and it stays there). Her RIGHT hand already holds her phone at chest height with its BACK to the camera (plain coral case, no logo; the screen is never seen). A sly smile, eyes on Timo, out of frame on the right. Coral shirt, plain teal scarf. Her head sits in the LOWER half of the frame; the upper third is soft sky and houses, kept free for the graphics.
shots.action: She says her first line, drops her eyes to the phone for a moment (one thumb taps once, hidden behind the phone), then looks up with a big easy grin and says her word. The folder does not move; the screen is never seen. Sound: her voice; typing, one ding and four pops from the edit. Music: the groove thins under the typing.
shots.venuvoy: 0.5 s: the VENUVOY name plate, top of frame. 0.7 to 2.1 s: the ivory card types word by word: "Manchester next weekend, football and a round of golf, me and Timo". After her "Done." (about 2.3 s) four ticks pop, 2.6 to 3.2 s: the match · ticket links · day by day and, last, a golf round. All held to the cut, more than a full second.

shots.place: The same pavement, camera position 2: close on Timo. Filmed as a 5-second clip; the last frame is held.
shots.who: Timo; soft behind him Luna, Big Yellow and the cat
shots.picture: Close on TIMO from the chest up, on the right half of the frame, his face in the upper middle, in three-quarter view toward Luna on the left (not full profile): the proud smile is gone, eyes wide, mouth a small flat line; backpack straps on both shoulders, teal-and-coral scarf, yellow watch on his LEFT wrist. Behind him on the left, soft: BIG YELLOW closed and upright, the CAT on its top in its usual place, LUNA standing beside it hugging the closed blue folder with both arms, grinning. The lower third of the frame is plain pale pavement, kept free for the sign-off.
shots.action: He says the one word in a small voice, then turns his head a quarter turn, slowly, to the camera and stares straight into it without another word; he blinks once. Nothing else moves. Music: a stop on the look, then the series' final hit under the sign-off.
shots.label: he has no plan for golf
shots.venuvoy: Sign-off from 1.3 s over the held stare, in the lower part of the frame, as in every episode: "one sentence. your sports trip, planned." / the VENUVOY name plate / "ep 1 · follow for ep 2" / "football, basketball, motorsport, tennis, golf and more".

open_question: Luna has typed their next trip, Manchester with football and a round of golf: what does Timo, the man of 42 steps, do in the one sport he has no plan for?
why_it_works:
Checked on paper only: nothing is drawn or filmed yet, and I did not check the live money balance. 11 shots, 37.9 seconds, two places.

THE BASE. Two of three judges and the highest total favour "No Folder", so it is the spine: the bare wall, "Done." in the wrong mouth, the heavy suitcase, the cat on his folder. The founder's eye called it thin on plot, stuck at home and unclear about who wins. Those three points drove every change.

THE PLOT NOW
- Claim: he has quit planning and carries only one sentence.
- Consequence: so she pushes Big Yellow, for the first time.
- Mystery: it is too heavy. "What did I pack?!" / "Maybe... the cat?", in silence.
- Turn, on the hard cut: the cat sits down on his folder inside her suitcase.
- Twist: the folder is his plan for having no plan, and she was in it. Step one he did on screen, step two she did, step three she is doing.
- Pay-off: his plan wins and she carries. Timo's first round ever is one clear picture, and the label mirrors season 1's "her plan wins. he carries."
- Comeback: her word returns to her with a new sentence, and the sport is the one he has no plan for.
Six labels tell it with the sound off; every line is captioned. The first ten seconds carry 15 spoken words.

WHAT THE JUDGES CHANGED
- Founder: the trip is on screen (a toy New York, an arena with a giant orange basketball on its roof, a hoop, a ball in her arms and in the suitcase). That is the alternative he offered to "a want and a clock"; I added no clock, because one the film does not pay off would dangle. Timo wins clearly, no label needs season 1, the hook is complete by itself, the open question is a picture, and Luna finds the folder laughing and has the last word.
- Animation supervisor: all his restagings are in. The phone starts flat on the chest; she points with a whole hand; no fringe; Timo stands still; the cat starts on the folder; the read-outs are one Luna single; the stare is a quarter turn with Luna standing in the background. The two-speaker room shot and the panic two-shot are gone, so no shot has two speakers.
- One departure from him, on purpose: the street is one new master, not place_uphill, because both other judges named "no destination on screen" as the weakest point. The figures in shot 4 still come from the season 1 ride (ep 4, clip g9): same direction, flat hands, a suitcase-width gap, slow. The street has three camera positions and one light. If the master does not hold the look, the same script plays on place_uphill without a changed word.
- Truth editor: the folder is named as not a trip plan the moment it appears, no step in it is a trip task, the tally label is replaced, and sport is in the picture.

GRAFTED
- From "One Shot": "Nine words. I counted.", "What did I pack?!", the basketball as a still prop, and the ending all three judges liked: Luna types the next trip, so the Venuvoy card is the cliffhanger.
- From the cat draft: the label "his plan wins. she carries."
- Kept for later episodes: "I love your folder.", "So I planned the cat.", the coral page.

VENUVOY, CHECKED AGAINST THE FACT SHEET
- Shot 2: the season 1 sentence, a place, a time and a sport; basketball games in New York are in the catalog; the four ticks are the ones used there. It has exactly nine words.
- Shot 10: football and a round of golf in Manchester; the sheet says the planner fits a golf round into a free day in London or Manchester. The tick is "a golf round", never a tee time.
- "Done." follows only a typed sentence. No ticket, booking, flight, hotel, price, stake or casino appears, and city names appear only inside the typed sentences.

SOUND: groove under shots 1 to 4, a full stop on "pack", one line in silence, the drop's first kick on the hard cut to the open suitcase, a thinner groove under the typing, a stop on the stare, the final hit under the sign-off.

MONEY AND RISK
- 11 clips, the fewest allowed: shots 2, 8, 10 and 11 as 5-second clips, the rest as 4-second clips, about 11.3 dollars before stills. season_1.md says about 12.6 remain, so there is at most one retake. Tell the founder before filming.
- Riskiest: shot 4 (two bodies walking; if feet slide, punch in to knees-up, and the label carries the story if his line fails), shot 7 (a new drawing of Big Yellow open), shot 8 (two read-outs with a quoted word; read it back with the word check), shot 1 (four elements; if crowded, the cat goes back on the windowsill as in season 1).
- No one-second "previously": it would take the film past 38 seconds, and the first label bridges the seasons.

TO CONFIRM BEFORE THE EDIT: that the real sentence box turns "a round of golf" into the golf round in the planner. The sheet proves the planner places the round in Manchester, not that the box reads those words.
